title: A chromosome-level genome assembly of the chilli thrips Scirtothrips dorsalis Hood (Thysanoptera: Thripidae)
authors: Busuulwa, A., Liesenfelt, T., Mongue, A. J. et al.
abstract: Thrips are known for being pests of many agricultural crops, as well as vectors of plant viruses. Yet despite their economic importance, genomic resources for this group remain limited, and no chromosome-level genome has been available for the genus Scirtothrips. One such species is the chilli thrips, Scirtothrips dorsalis Hood (Thysanoptera: Thripidae). title: Morphogenomic description of Cranifera cranifera (Chitwood, 1932) Kloss, 1960 from captive Blaptica dubia Serville, 1838 cockroach
authors: Morffe, J., Guiglielmoni, N., Wassey, N. et al.
abstract: Nematodes of the superfamily Thelastomatoidea are found in the digestive system of various arthropods, feeding on their host microbiome. They are sometimes considered to be ecologically intermediate forms between free-living rhabditids and parasitic Spirurina, while phylogenetically they are nested within the latter.
